value: Very high-scope adventure game with high quality illustrations, interactive gameplay with body exploration and high variety of scenarios. Contains extensive narrative with complete endings.

You play as the hero. After defeated a supposed “demon lord”, a giant girl calling herself the real demon lord appears and destroys your country. Instantly obliterated with a single breath, your consciousness briefly fades before your goddess brings you back to life. She asks you to journey into the demon lord’s world to stop her before she destroys your whole world, aiding you with her weakened goddess powers. Upon travelling to the other world you are confronted with the reality that what you formerly thought was an immortal “demon lord” is actually just a cockroach from the other world, and that you are simply tiny compared to the citizens of this world.
